findings: Since Jun 2026 (20 Mon–Sun weeks): Meta spend vs organic halo revenue correlates weakly (lag-0 r≈0.45, lag-1 r≈0.2) — moves together sometimes, not lockstep.
Meta-attributed Shopify sales track halo better than spend alone (lag-0 r≈0.4). Good Meta weeks avg ~$4722.0 organic halo vs ~$4189.0 on bad weeks.
Rule-of-thumb from weekly data: ~$1.135 organic halo Shopify $ per $1 Meta spend (non-causal; includes Oct partial week).
